points.description: States at least 4 valid objectives of IPv6, e.g. support billions of end-systems (larger address space), reduce routing tables, simplified header/protocol processing, increased security, real-time/QoS support (flow label, traffic class), multicasting, mobility, openness to future change (extension headers), coexistence with existing protocols. Equivalent wording accepted; any correct objectives count.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only 2–3 valid objectives are given.
